notes: Initial sibling-config isolation caused six launcher/adapter timeouts on both main and head. Nesting sandbox paths fixed the probe file; the bootstrap adapter fixture now uses its entire sandbox as TMPDIR. Final runs pass.
The unadapted Viewer verifier refused one module under the stage scratch layout; its private TMPDIR-only adaptation loaded all 25 modules and served HTTP 200.

The full type check was rerun successfully after correcting two test result types. A long combined campaign was interrupted during a prior type-check attempt; the final compiler run used its own owned runner.
Two existing Docker busy-container/native-worker adapter cases remain opt-in and skipped.
Required hosted checks follow Delegatus publication. No deployment was part of this verification.
